sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Christmas Island Applied Laws Ordinance 1992 (compilation of 19 November 2025), Schedule, Part 29: Public and Bank Holidays Act 1972 (W.A.)(C.I.)
sources.said: Second Schedule — Public Holidays and Bank Holidays 1. New Year’s Day (1 January) 2. Australia Day (26 January) 3. Chinese New Year’s Day (Day 1) (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 4. Chinese New Year’s Day (Day 2) (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 5. The Muslim festival day known as Hari Raya Puasa (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 6. Labour Day (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 7. Good Friday 8. Anzac Day (25 April) 9. The Muslim festival day known as Hari Raya Haji (to be appointed annually by proclamation published in the Gazette before the day so appointed) 10. Territory Day (the first Monday in October) 11. Christmas Day (25 December) 12. Boxing Day (26 December) 13. If a day referred to in item 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 11 falls on a Saturday or Sunday—the immediately following Monday 14. If a day referred to in item 4 or 12 falls on a Saturday—the immediately following Monday 15. If a day referred to in item 4 or 12 falls on a Sunday or Monday—the immediately following Tuesday
sources.note: The compilation's text, saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/cx-alo.txt (from its document_1.html). It replaces the applied Western Australian Act's Schedule for the Territory.

sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Notice – Proclamation – Special Public & Bank Holidays 2026, Territory of Christmas Island, No 01/2025 (11 September 2025)

sources.note: The Administrator's proclamation under the Public and Bank Holidays Act 1972 (WA)(CI), saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/frl-F2025N00750-doc.html. sources.title: Federal Register of Legislation, Notice – Proclamation – Special Public & Bank Holidays 2027, Territory of Christmas Island, No 01/2026 (24 July 2026)
sources.said: Chinese New Year (Day 1) Monday, 8 February 2027 Chinese New Year (Day 2) Tuesday, 9 February 2027 Labour Day Monday, 22 March 2027 Hari Raya Puasa Tuesday, 9 March 2027* Hari Raya Haji Monday, 17 May 2027*
sources.note: Saved at /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-SLATE/c8b0b159-b4a5-540a-bbd6-18661cbe240c/scratchpad/dl/w16h2/frl-F2026N00560-doc.html. The Schedule has no Easter Monday for Christmas Island, and doesn't move Australia Day, Good Friday or Territory Day. Readings: a day appointed by proclamation is kept on the day the proclamation gives, not moved again; Christmas Day moved to a Monday keeps that Monday even when it is Boxing Day's, which then goes to the Tuesday (items 13 and 15). The Islamic days are as proclaimed, which the proclamations say may move by a day or two with the moon; a later change wasn't looked for. From 2028 only the Schedule's fixed days are kept (announced to 2027). The lists are the rules' days for 2026 and 2027, which give each proclamation's days.
